title: Show HN: Open-source private home security camera system (end-to-end encryption)
summary: Secluso is an open-source, privacy-focused home security camera system featuring end-to-end encryption via OpenMLS, evolved from the original 'Privastead' project. Originally launched in 2024, the system now offers simplified Raspberry Pi setup, allowing users to self-host a private surveillance solution without relying on cloud services.
problem_solved: Addresses privacy concerns with traditional cloud-based security cameras by providing a self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted alternative that keeps footage under user control.
why_valuable: Empowers privacy-conscious users to maintain full control over their home surveillance data through open-source technology and strong encryption, eliminating vendor lock-in and subscription costs.
